subject: Retention anchor / 24-month price lock request - GreenLeaf Health
messages:
From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
To: Linda Park <linda.park@greenleafhealth.com>, procure@greenleafhealth.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Retention anchor / 24-month price lock request - GreenLeaf Health

Hi Linda / Procurement team,

Thanks again for taking the call yesterday — great to hear how you’re planning a phased rollout of Redwood Dedicated across three clinical lines. Per our conversation I attached an updated SOW (v3) and a short term sheet with the commercial ask. High level: GreenLeaf is proposing a 24-month committed purchase (reserved capacity) with a request for a fixed per-token price for the full term plus an uplift cap at renewal (no more than +5% in year 3 on list price). They are also asking for a renewal protection clause (right to match any materially similar public offering for first renewal) and a one-time onboarding credit of $50k to offset migration services.

Attachments: GreenLeaf_Draft_SOW_v3.pdf, term_sheet_redlines.docx

I’ve copied our deal desk and finance partners. From Redwood’s side we’ll need executive approval for (1) a 24-month price lock, (2) an uplift cap of 5% at renewal, and (3) the onboarding credit. Please let us know any immediate questions — if this shape is OK I’ll request sign-off and draft the final amendment.

Next step I’m proposing: internal approval thread this morning, then send a conditional LOI to Procurement by EOD.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

Redwood Inference — Developer-first inference for production LLMs

From: Linda Park <linda.park@greenleafhealth.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Retention anchor / 24-month price lock request - GreenLeaf Health

On Thu, Apr 22, 2027 at 9:12 AM soojin_lee@redwood.ai wrote:
> Thanks again for taking the call yesterday...

Thanks Soojin — that summary is correct and appreciated. A couple of clarifying notes from Procurement: 1) The onboarding credit needs to be recognized as a service credit applied against the first invoice; 2) The renewal protection we referenced is specifically about pricing parity: if Redwood introduces a materially similar dedicated offering at a lower price within the renewal window, GreenLeaf should be entitled to match that lower price for 12 months (we called it a "first renewal match").

Procurement is comfortable moving forward promptly if we can get written confirmation on the price lock + uplift cap and the credit handling. Can you get back with the approvals by EOD? We’re targeting legal review next week.

Best,
Linda Park
Director, Procurement | GreenLeaf Health
linda.park@greenleafhealth.com

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 11:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Retention anchor / 24-month price lock request - GreenLeaf Health

Looping deal desk and Markus for exec consideration. Summary points from Soojin/Linda: 24 mo committed reserved capacity; request full-term price lock; renewal uplift cap at +5%; first-renewal match clause; $50k onboarding credit applied against first invoice.

My read: GreenLeaf is strategic in healthcare (regional chain, good AP/scale) and this is a good anchor for the east region. We can consider a price-lock conditional on approving a modest contraction in discount: limit to no greater than a 20% TCV discount from list, and we require a firm minimum committed QPS level in the SOW to avoid underutilization risk (see SOW section 2.1). Also recommend we convert the onboarding credit into a one-time implementation credit that is amortized over the first invoice (accounting prefers credit treatment).

Requesting executive sign-off for the deviations: price lock for 24 months, uplift cap 5%, renewal first-match clause, and $50k onboarding credit (applied to first invoice as service credit). If approved, Legal will prepare the amendment and I’ll send the conditional LOI to Procurement.

- Marissa
Marissa Cole | Director, Enterprise Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Retention anchor / 24-month price lock request - GreenLeaf Health

Thanks for the context — I approve the commercial deviations with the following conditions: 1) Max total discount over list must not exceed 20% TCV (as Marissa suggested); 2) Price lock limited to the contracted SKU/instance configuration in the SOW — any materially different SKU or consumption tier will be priced at prevailing list; 3) Renewal uplift cap of +5% is acceptable only if Legal signs off on the exact "first renewal match" language and we add a 30-day notification window for Redwood to present a competitive pricing match; 4) The $50k onboarding credit is approved on the condition it is applied as a one-time service credit on invoice #1 and explicitly amortized in accounting notes.

Operational asks: Ben, please confirm that we can enforce the committed QPS minimum in the serving config and add monitoring hooks in the Console so we can identify under-utilization and trigger remediation. Legal will need the term sheet redlines.

Markus Klein
VP, Revenue — Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.ai

From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
To: Linda Park <linda.park@greenleafhealth.com>, procure@greenleafhealth.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 16:04:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Retention anchor / 24-month price lock request - GreenLeaf Health

Linda — thanks for the quick turnaround and for surfacing Procurement’s requirements. Good news: Redwood has approved the requested commercial shape with executive conditions. Confirmed items below (subject to Legal amendment/redline):

- 24-month firm commitment with a price lock for the contracted SKUs/configs listed in SOW v3.
- Renewal uplift cap of +5% (year 3 list price) with a first-renewal-match right for GreenLeaf; Legal will include a 30-day notice window and exact matching language as a carve-out for materially similar public offerings.
- $50,000 onboarding/service credit applied to first invoice and noted in accounting as amortized credit.
- Max TCV discount not to exceed 20% off list.
- Commitment minimums and monitoring: SOW section 2.1 to specify the committed QPS; Ben will add Console monitoring hooks and an under-utilization remediation path.

Next steps: Legal will send redlines to both teams tomorrow; pending those redlines we can issue a conditional LOI for signature. Please reply if any of these conditions are a blocker.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this across the finish line.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
